searchText: sorry i was late for the standup(i joined 40mins late) but write-up is here: https://hackmd.io/_DZz3ZsOSC-3_m26r8sFGw Recording from the AMA with Michael here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1zij6gwBVdw9KGQn62ZDyhbHnI1nziNHB/view?usp=sharing <@&857649635274915900> Office Hours AMA news! Next session will bring yet another mentor - Alex Stokes from EF Research. Alex is well know researcher in domains of MEV, CL and light clients. Also big time Rust lover 🙂 Many of you folks work on related things, hope you will bring some interesting questions once again. It's back to a normal time slot, 3pm UTC on Tuesday. https://github.com/eth-protocol-fellows/cohort-four/issues/403 Listening to fellows progress, there are more and more of us who are feeling more confident about things that we do, so great, congrats and lets keep up the pace 😀 Btw if anyone is in chiang mai, thailand, or want to come here there's an organization providing free accomodation: https://beacons.ai/the_mu former fellows are here, its fun. I came 2 days ago, would recommend must be really fun! Quick reminder to all <@&857649635274915900>. You **MUST** be posting, at a minimum, bi-weekly development updates. These are not only a requirement of your stipend and fellowship, but they are helpful to practice your technical writing skills, conveying your ideas to others, and allowing others to find information about the topics you are working on.
